intro.text: The Book of Endless Pages, a religious work on Roshar, belongs to the Devotary of Sincerity.

description.text: Its pages are all left blank: the devotary holds that learning never ends, so the book can never be complete.
The Devotary of Sincerity that the book stands for is a sect of Vorinism.

items.text: Jasnah was given a copy by someone hoping to convert her. The attempt failed, though it came closer than anyone else ever had.
Jasnah passed the book on to Shallan, telling her that the search for truth is a virtue in every case. Shallan was surprised that such a devotary existed.
Shallan lost her copy when the Wind's Pleasure sank, still feeling she had not fully grasped what it meant.
